messages.text: Antonelli wins Spanish GP after luckless Norris loses out

metadata.summary: Kimi Antonelli took another step in his quest towards winning the 2026 world championship by benefitting from pit-stop misfortune for Lando Norris to win the first Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring.
metadata.content: Spanish GP: Kimi Antonelli wins F1's first Madring race to increase title lead after Lando Norris misfortune | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to content Spanish GP: Kimi Antonelli wins F1's first Madring race to increase title lead after Lando Norris misfortune Kimi Antonelli increased his championship lead to a commanding 81 points with his eighth race win of the year; Lando Norris appeared to have race under control before untimely Virtual Safety Car lost him the lead; Max Verstappen second, while Lewis Hamilton suffered first DNF of his season Sunday 13 September 2026 17:25, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix Kimi Antonelli took another step in his quest towards winning the 2026 world championship by benefitting from pit-stop misfortune for Lando Norris to win the first Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring. McLaren's Norris had looked in control of the race after converting his superb pole position into a comfortable early race lead but the battle for victory turned on a lap-14 Virtual Safety Car when Aston Martin's Lance Stroll stopped in a run-off area. With a VSC offering the field the chance of a so-called 'cheap' pit stop, McLaren were unable to pit Norris immediately as the Briton had just passed the pit-lane entry road.
